_about: Copy this file to labs-config.json (git-ignored) and replace every REPLACE value. Never commit labs-config.json: it names your subscription. Validate with: bash infra/check-config.sh

foundry._about: resourceName must be globally unique because it becomes the custom subdomain of the endpoint.

deployments._about: One entry per model deployment. Find valid versions and SKUs with: bash infra/list-models.sh <name>. An entry whose modelVersion still starts with REPLACE is skipped.
